designationHistory.name: Charles Sheldon Wild Life Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Herbert Hoover established the Charles Sheldon Wild Life Refuge by Executive Order 5540 on January 26, 1931, as a refuge and breeding ground for wild animals and birds.
